Meet The Co-Founder
Anna Hsu
Co-Founder

Anna Hsu co-founded Empowered PC on a simple idea: a custom PC should be built by people who stand behind it. Every system that leaves our bench is assembled in the USA, and when you need help, you reach our own US-based support team, for the life of the machine.

More Than Gaming

The same bench that builds our gaming rigs also builds AI and multi-GPU workstations, professional workstations, and rackstation servers. One team, one standard: assembled in the USA, and supported by our own US-based team for the life of the machine.
